notes: Large-source unit כָּל־הַיָּמִים → perpetually retained: the one adverb carries the quantifier, the article's determination and the noun, as the corpus reads the same phrase → 'for ever' (rule 30); head on the governing כֹּל (rule 23), with יָמִים as competing head. 'For now' divides between the waw and עַתָּה (rule 14).
